title: Akiyama Mizuki — What Gave Me Courage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not quite 25:00 yet, but I wonder if everyone's logged in...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Geez, you scared me. Do you have to be so loud?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Sorry about that!
But it looks like we're all here already.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes... However, I'm going to have a midnight snack, so I'll be coming back later...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Then, can we chat for a bit before you do that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, hold up!
There's something I wanna ask all of you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you're gonna send pictures of us to your sister?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! Like pics of our mystery tour, that picnic we went on, the Sports Festival and our visit to PXL...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Stuff that shows me smiling and genuinely enjoying life, you know♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I see...
Well, if that's the case, I guess I wouldn't mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't mind if they're meant for your sister...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, these are the pics that I'm thinking about sending her...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, this is of that cherry blossom tree we saw by the abandoned school during our mystery tour...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <And here's one of us at the diner...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? Oh, you're right...
Hang on... This parfait's pretty much all gone.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wasn't this the deluxe parfait that was only available for a limited time? Shouldn't you choose a pic that shows what it looked like before we ate it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's all good. I wanted a pic that focused less on the parfait and more on us having fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, also!
Enanan, didn't you take a bunch of pics during the Sports Festival and when we went to PXL? Could you send me some of your favorites?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I did. Gimme a sec to go through them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, Amia, your sister lives abroad, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, she's working as a designer overseas.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's so incredible.
Going over all alone and even working there.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it is. I mean, just overcoming the language barrier must've been really tough.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Actually, knowing Sis, she probably didn't have any trouble with that whatsoever...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Especially since she'd rather not change her style or how she expresses herself to get acknowledged by others.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is why she moved to a place where her peers accept her for who she is and how she thinks... A place where she feels she belongs...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool!
The pictures are all nice and gussied up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now to put them into an envelope...
But there's a lot. Are they all gonna fit...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, they fit!
I'm glad I got a bigger-sized envelope for this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That just leaves my greeting card.
Oh, I should decorate it with some shiny Mia stickers for some added nostalgia...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder what Sis is gonna think when she sees these pics.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she might immediately pick up on how I'm doing right now after seeing this ribbon sticker.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Mom!
Can you include this in your package for Sis?!
